description: Paste CSV data and get parameterless SQL INSERT statements back, with basic type inference: unquoted for integers/decimals and true/false, NULL for empty cells, single-quoted (with '' escaping) for everything else. Column and table identifiers are quoted per the chosen dialect so reserved words and mixed-case names round-trip safely.

batchSize.description: Rows per INSERT statement (default 1, one statement per row)

csv.description: CSV data with a header row

dialect.description: Identifier quoting style: ANSI double quotes or MySQL backticks (default "ansi")

tableName.description: Target table name, must be a valid SQL identifier (default "my_table")

name: csv_to_sql_insert
